title: Cube transfer A → B
task: Move the cube from A to B.
description: Teleoperate the leader arm so that the follower picks the cube at A and places it in target area B. The recording becomes the reference input of the Modelica follower simulation.

manipulator.frame: follower base_link (display offset only, no measured registration)

visual_grasp.gripper_measure: normalised leader finger opening (0 closed, 1 open)
visual_grasp.release: on opening, the cube drops vertically to the table surface
visual_grasp.orientation: ignored: attachment depends on fingertip position only

engineering_questions: Why does the follower deviate from the leader trajectory during the transfer?
Which actuator, control or friction parameters of the shoulder dominate the tracking error?
How would a cube payload change the required shoulder torque? (not modelled at Level 1)
